footer.tagline: Convenient, transparent car rental. Book online in minutes, no account required.

hero.body: Pick your dates, choose your car, and drive off in minutes. No account required, and the price you see is the price you pay.

howItWorks.step1Body: Pick a city near you from dozens of pick-up points across the country.
howItWorks.step2Body: Tell us when you need the car and for how long. We'll hold it for you.
howItWorks.step3Body: Confirm your details and you're set. Your ride will be ready and waiting.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Us
whyChooseUs.subtitle: A high-performing car rental service built around convenience, transparency, and reliability.
whyChooseUs.imageAlt: City street at night with a car driving toward the skyline
whyChooseUs.supportBody: Our support team is on call around the clock, so help is always a phone call away.
whyChooseUs.priceBody: Transparent, competitive daily rates with no hidden fees at pick-up.
whyChooseUs.locationBody: Pick up and drop off at convenient locations in every major city we serve.
